query: Отревьюь эту схему перед тем как мы её задеплоим в продакшн на PostgreSQL. Что здесь сломается под нагрузкой?
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/schema_audit.py rather than eyeballing the DDL
Explains each finding in terms of the engine mechanism, not as a style preference
Prioritises findings by impact and gives concrete corrected DDL
assertions: Report names the random UUIDv4 primary key on customers as a problem and explains page splits / index bloat
Report flags payments.order_id as a foreign key with no index
Report flags orders.total and payments.amount as money stored in double precision
Report identifies idx_orders_customer as redundant with idx_orders_customer_status via the leftmost prefix rule
Report identifies product_attributes as an EAV antipattern
Report does NOT recommend dropping an index without saying to verify zero scans on replicas first
